title: Design System: 卢春翔个人主页

display.purpose: Page-level titles and the Chinese name in the profile rail.

headline.purpose: Research, experience, honors and long-form section headings.

title.purpose: Research projects, organizations and nested project names.

body.purpose: Descriptions, evidence, limitations and supporting information.

lead.purpose: Opening profile and page introductions with a constrained reading measure.

label.purpose: Dates, numbered section markers, metadata and compact navigation.

shadows.name: reading-progress-glow
shadows.purpose: Only for the two-pixel reading progress indicator in the dark rail.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: Underlines, small accent reveals and restrained spatial transitions.

motion.name: ease-page-wash
motion.purpose: LCX page opening and same-origin page transitions only.

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and compact control feedback.

motion.name: archive-cursor-follow
motion.purpose: Desktop fine-pointer ring following; context labels state link intent without obscuring content.

motion.name: archive-click-stamp
motion.purpose: Single double-ring confirmation after a primary pointer press; disabled on touch and reduced-motion paths.

breakpoints.name: profile-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Convert the fixed profile rail and timeline grids into a single-column mobile document.

components.name: LCX Monogram
components.description: Circular author mark used once in the profile rail.
components.css: .ds-monogram { display:grid; place-items:center; width:68px; height:68px; border:1px solid rgba(232,224,210,.72); border-radius:50%; background:var(--rail,#242522); color:var(--rail-ink,#e8e0d2); font:700 17px/1 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:-.08em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-monogram:hover { color:#fff; border-color:var(--accent-bright,#bd744d); } .ds-monogram:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#bd744d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Button
components.description: Plain-language MENU/CLOSE control for the stacked profile header.
components.css: .ds-menu { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:44px; min-height:44px; padding:7px 9px; border:1px solid rgba(232,224,210,.34); border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--rail-ink,#e8e0d2); font:700 9px SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-menu:hover { border-color:var(--accent-bright,#bd744d); } .ds-menu:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#bd744d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Section Kicker
components.description: Numbered archive marker introducing one major document section.
components.css: .ds-kicker { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; margin:0; color:var(--accent,#9a5735); font:700 10px/1 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-kicker::after { content:""; width:32px; height:1px; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Timeline Entry
components.description: Open, border-separated research or experience record with a date column.
components.html:
2026.03—Present

研究项目标题

项目角色与说明。
components.css: .ds-entry { display:grid; grid-template-columns:156px minmax(0,1fr); gap:30px; padding:25px 7px 25px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(66,57,49,.18); color:var(--muted,#6d675f); transition:background .3s ease,padding .35s ease; } .ds-entry time { color:var(--soft,#726960); font:600 10px/1.6 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-entry h3 { margin:0 0 5px; color:var(--ink,#292824); font:500 18px/1.48 Georgia,serif; } .ds-entry p { margin:0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.86; } .ds-entry:hover { padding-left:10px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(154,87,53,.055),transparent 72%); }

components.name: Inline Evidence Link
components.description: Compact project-detail or repository link with a directional underline.
components.html: 查看研究项目详情 →
components.css: .ds-inline-link { position:relative; color:#744128; font:700 11px/1.6 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; text-decoration:none; } .ds-inline-link::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-2px; height:1px; background:currentColor; transform:scaleX(.15); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-inline-link:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-inline-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#bd744d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Profile Navigation Link
components.description: Numbered rail navigation with subdued default and clear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display:grid; grid-template-columns:25px 1fr; align-items:center; min-height:27px; color:rgba(232,224,210,.58); font:700 11px/1 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; text-decoration:none; transition:color .25s ease,transform .25s ease; } .ds-nav-link span { color:rgba(232,224,210,.22); font-size:8px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:var(--rail-ink,#e8e0d2); transform:translateX(3px); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color:#fff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#bd744d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Archive Ring Cursor
components.description: Fine-pointer-only 30px ring and 5px center dot with contextual destination labels and one-shot click stamp feedback. The custom cursor remains visible over text.
components.css: .cursor-ring { width:30px; height:30px; color:var(--accent,#9a5735); border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:50%; } .cursor-label { font:700 8px/1 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.14em; }

narrative.northStar: The Research Dossier / 研究档案
narrative.overview: 网站像一份持续更新的个人研究档案，而不是演示文稿、产品宣传页或卡片式作品集。深色资料栏保存稳定身份，暖色正文区域连续展开研究、实习、荣誉与笔记。视觉兴趣来自字体关系、纸张质感、时间线、细线和少量棕色强调，内容始终先于效果。
keyCharacteristics: 深色资料栏与暖色连续正文形成稳定双区结构。
研究和实习按时间线组织，详细页面保持长文阅读逻辑。
衬线标题、无衬线正文和等宽元信息各司其职。
棕色强调保持稀少且具有信息作用。
动画不能遮挡或延迟阅读。
桌面光标以圆环、中心点和简短去向标签提供反馈，经过正文时保持可见，点击只出现一次轻量印章。

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: 棕色强调必须有信息作用；同一视口内不同时制造多个棕色视觉中心。

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: 页面只保留深色资料栏和暖纸正文两种主表面。

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: 每类文字只使用衬线标题、无衬线正文、等宽元信息中的一种明确角色。

rules.name: The Continuous Document Rule
rules.body: 主页面依靠标题、时间、细线和留白分节，不使用等高卡片网格或满屏分镜。

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: 静态内容保持平面；阴影、光晕和位移只用于状态反馈或签名细节。

dos: Do 保留左侧身份资料与右侧连续研究档案的明确分工。
Do 用时间、角色、方法、结果、限制和公开链接组织项目内容。
Do 在桌面与手机端同时检查首屏、长标题、44px 触控目标和 200% 缩放。
donts: Don't 使用 PPT 式满屏分段或巨型口号。
Don't 将所有内容改成圆角卡片矩阵。
Don't 使用与学术档案无关的紫蓝渐变、玻璃拟态或霓虹光效。
Don't 让动画遮挡、延迟或反复打断阅读。
